findings.description: start_id and end_id are not validated against m->nr_nodes.
Negative indices from data (e.g., way_ids[i], node_ids[j]) could lead to OOB access.
VLA size equals m->nr_nodes; large or untrusted values can cause stack overflow or write out-of-bounds.
Missing validation of predecessor chain length during path reconstruction.
Unchecked memory allocations.
Potential integer overflow computing allocation sizes.
Potential null dereference/use-after-failure of MinHeap creation.
No cleanup of the heap.
Use of untrusted graph metadata (num_ways, num_nodes, way_ids, node_ids) without cross-checking declared counts.
Potential NaN/Inf arithmetic when adding DBL_MAX and absence of checks for invalid travel time values.
